## Review checklist

- [ ] The committed `rtl-anywhere.user.js` is updated when `src/` changes.
- [ ] No new network API usage was added unless explicitly reviewed.
- [ ] No new userscript grants were added unless README and SECURITY.md were updated.

- [ ] UI changes were checked in `test/harness.html` or covered by smoke tests.
